title: Permissioned seeder is idempotent and reconciles with existing empty-permission roles
preconds: Test tenant where the legacy 10 empty-permission roles already exist (pre-migration state). CRP-BE-07 seeder available.
steps:
1. Capture current count of system roles per org (expect 10).
2. Run the seeder.
3. Capture new count.
4. Inspect a known role (e.g. Administrator) and confirm it now has the matrix-defined bundle set attached, NOT duplicated as a second Administrator row.
5. Re-run the seeder.
6. Confirm no further changes — idempotent.
expected:
Step 3: Count moves from 10 to 11 system roles per org (Sr SA / Jr SA / Sales Rep split; Owner template no longer seeded per spec 6/10). [Note: ticket SV-7482's title still says 10->12 — it pre-dates the 6/10 Owner removal. End state per spec v15 is 11 roles. Flag to Sasha/BE to update the ticket.]
Step 4: Existing Administrator row was UPDATED with the matrix bundle set (not duplicated).
Step 6: Second run is a no-op.
